resources.string: Tells you at once when BOAR doesn\'t speak your language yet.
Sorry, BOAR doesn\'t speak {{language}} yet. Ask in English or Portuguese.
Как долго нужно кипятить воду, чтобы она была безопасной?
烧水需要多长时间才能安全饮用？
Πόση ώρα πρέπει να βράσει το νερό για να είναι πόσιμο;
BOAR is tested in {{languages}}. If you ask in another language, Polyglot says so instead of giving a confused answer.
Как долго нужно кипятить воду, чтобы она была безопасной?

• It replies at once to a full question in a language BOAR doesn't speak yet, instead of a confused answer.
• Other alphabets are known by their letters (Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Thai, Greek and more).
• French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish or Turkish only when the phone's language detector is sure (Android 10 and later).
• Short messages, greetings, names, quotes, code, links, a short follow-up, and a question with English in it (What does 'merci' mean?) go to the model.
• The answer's details say Tool: language.
